<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>UMED - UMED Pharma lab Pvt.Ltd</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --primary:#1677f2;--primary2:#0d62d8;--navy:#06213f;--bg:#f4f7fb;
  --text:#172033;--muted:#6b7280;--border:#dce3ec;--success:#18a957;--danger:#dc3545;
}
body{font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);min-height:100vh}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:0}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.toast{position:fixed;right:22px;top:22px;z-index:9999;background:#172033;color:white;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0002;display:none}
.toast.show{display:block;animation:fade .25s ease}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* Auth */
.auth-wrap{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(6,33,63,.75),rgba(13,79,147,.7) 55%,rgba(22,119,242,.65)),url(data:image/webp;base64,) center/cover no-repeat}
.auth-card{width:min(430px,100%);background:white;border-radius:18px;padding:34px;box-shadow:0 25px 70px #001b3b55}
.logo{text-align:center;font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:8px}
.logo span{color:var(--primary)}
.auth-sub{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:25px}
.tabs{display:flex;background:#edf3fa;padding:4px;border-radius:9px;margin-bottom:23px}
.tabs button{flex:1;padding:10px;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:#526071;font-weight:600}
.tabs button.active{background:white;color:var(--primary);box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0000000d}
.form-group{margin-bottom:15px}
.form-group label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px}
.form-group input,.form-group select,.form-group textarea,.search{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 12px;outline:none;background:white}
.form-group input:focus,.form-group select:focus,.form-group textarea:focus,.search:focus{border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #1677f215}
.btn{padding:11px 18px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700}
.btn-primary{background:var(--primary);color:white}.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--primary2)}
.btn-success{background:var(--success);color:white}
.btn-danger{background:var(--danger);color:white}
.btn-light{background:#edf2f7;color:#263449}
.full{width:100%}
.demo-note{margin-top:17px;padding:11px;background:#fff7df;border:1px solid #f3df9c;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;color:#775d0a}

/* App */
.app{display:none;min-height:100vh}
.sidebar{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:215px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#061e3a,#02172d);color:white;padding:20px 10px;z-index:20}
.brand{font-size:23px;font-weight:800;padding:0 12px 28px;color:var(--primary)}
.brand span{color:var(--primary)}
.nav a{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;color:#dbe9f9;text-decoration:none;border-radius:7px;margin-bottom:5px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.nav a.active,.nav a:hover{background:var(--primary);color:white}
.sidebar-bottom{position:absolute;bottom:18px;left:20px;right:20px;font-size:11px;color:#8ea3ba}
.main{margin-left:215px;min-height:100vh}
.topbar{height:65px;background:white;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 24px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10}
.topbar h1{font-size:23px}.user{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.content{padding:20px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.card{background:white;border:1px solid #e4e9ef;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #10233d06}
.card-head{padding:15px;border-bottom:1px solid #e7ebf0;font-weight:800}
.card-body{padding:15px}
.upload-box{border:1.5px dashed #bbc8d8;border-radius:8px;padding:23px;text-align:center;color:#687588;margin-bottom:15px;transition:.2s}
.upload-box.drag{background:#eef6ff;border-color:var(--primary)}
.upload-icon{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:6px}.upload-title{font-weight:700;color:#243248}
.small{font-size:12px;color:#7b8796}
.file-list{margin-top:8px;font-size:12px}.file-list div{padding:5px 7px;background:#f4f7fb;border-radius:5px;margin-top:4px}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:88px}
.submit-row{text-align:center;margin-top:13px}
.table-card{margin-top:20px}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:1050px;font-size:12px}
th,td{padding:11px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e9ee;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}
th{background:#f7f9fb;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#687588;white-space:nowrap}
.thumb{width:48px;height:40px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid #ddd}
.link{color:var(--primary);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:20px;background:#eaf3ff;color:#1768c8;font-weight:700;font-size:10px}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #e7ebf0}
.toolbar .search{max-width:340px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px}
.stat{background:white;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;padding:17px}
.stat .n{font-size:25px;font-weight:800}.stat .l{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}

/* Modal */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#00152a88;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:100;padding:20px}
.modal.open{display:flex}.modal-box{background:white;border-radius:12px;width:min(650px,100%);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto}
.modal-head{padding:15px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:800}
.modal-body{padding:18px}.close{font-size:22px;background:none;color:#6b7280}
.preview-img{max-width:100%;max-height:350px;display:block;margin:10px auto;border-radius:8px}

/* responsive */
@media(max-width:900px){
 .sidebar{width:70px}.brand{font-size:0;padding:15px 10px 28px}
 .nav a{font-size:0;justify-content:center}.nav a span{font-size:20px}.sidebar-bottom{display:none}.main{margin-left:70px}
 .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
 .topbar{padding:0 13px}.topbar h1{font-size:18px}.content{padding:12px}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.auth-card{padding:24px}
}
/* mobile: bottom tab bar instead of side nav */
@media(max-width:680px){
 .sidebar{width:100%;height:60px;top:auto;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;box-shadow:0 -4px 20px #0002;z-index:30}
 .brand{display:none}
 .sidebar-bottom{display:none}
 .nav{display:flex;flex-direction:row;width:100%;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
 .nav a{flex:0 0 auto;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:8px 14px;margin-bottom:0;border-radius:8px;font-size:0}
 .nav a span{font-size:19px}
 .main{margin-left:0;padding-bottom:60px}
 .topbar{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;height:auto;padding:10px 13px}
 .topbar h1{font-size:17px;width:100%}
 .topbar>div{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}
 .user{font-size:12px}
 #dashContactAdmin{padding:7px 11px;font-size:12px}
 .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
 .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
 .stat{padding:12px}.stat .n{font-size:20px}
 .card-head{padding:12px;font-size:14px}.card-body{padding:12px}
 .toolbar{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px}
 .toolbar .search{max-width:100%}
 .upload-box{padding:16px}
 .auth-wrap{padding:14px}
 .auth-card{padding:20px;border-radius:14px}
 .modal-box{border-radius:10px}
 .modal-body{padding:14px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="toast" class="toast"></div>

<!-- LOGIN / REGISTRATION -->
<section id="auth" class="auth-wrap">
  <div class="auth-card">
    <div class="logo"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Bhavi" style="height:70px"></div>
    <div class="auth-sub">Bhavyanshi DMS</div>
    <div class="tabs">
      <button id="loginTab" class="active" onclick="showAuth('login')">Login</button>
      <button id="registerTab" onclick="showAuth('register')">Registration</button>
    </div>

    <form id="loginForm" onsubmit="login(event)">
      <div class="form-group"><label>Email</label><input id="loginEmail" type="email" required placeholder="Enter email"></div>
      <div class="form-group">
        <label>Password</label>
        <input id="loginPassword" type="password" required placeholder="Enter password">
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary full">Login</button>
      <div class="demo-note">Having trouble logging in? <a href="#" onclick="event.preventDefault();showAdminContact()"><b>Contact Admin</b></a></div>
    </form>

    <form id="registerForm" class="hidden" onsubmit="register(event)">
      <div class="form-group"><label>Full Name</label><input id="regName" required placeholder="Enter full name"></div>
      <div class="form-group"><label>UPL Number</label><input id="regUpl" required placeholder="Enter UPL number"></div>
      <div class="form-group"><label>Email</label><input id="regEmail" type="email" required placeholder="Enter email"></div>
      <div class="form-group"><label>Mobile Number</label><input id="regMobile" type="tel" required pattern="[0-9]{10}" maxlength="10" placeholder="Enter 10-digit mobile number"></div>
      <div class="form-group"><label>Password</label><input id="regPassword" type="password" minlength="6" required placeholder="Minimum 6 characters"></div>
      <div class="form-group"><label>Confirm Password</label><input id="regConfirm" type="password" required placeholder="Confirm password"></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary full">Create Account</button>
    </form>
    <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:16px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">Powered By Sai Kowshik</div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- APPLICATION -->
<div id="app" class="app">
  <aside class="sidebar">
    <div class="brand"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Bhavi" style="height:28px;vertical-align:middle;border-radius:4px"> Bhavi</div>
    <nav class="nav">
      <a href="#" id="navDash" class="active" onclick="page('dashboard')"><span>⌂</span><b>Dashboard</b></a>
      <a href="#" id="navWork" onclick="page('work')"><span>▣</span><b>My Work</b></a>
      <a href="#" id="navAdmin" onclick="page('admin')"><span>♙</span><b>Admin Panel</b></a>
      <a href="#" id="navUsers" onclick="page('users')"><span>👥</span><b>Registered Users</b></a>
      <a href="#" id="navMessages" onclick="page('messages')"><span>✉</span><b>Contact Messages</b></a>
      <a href="#" id="navTeamLead" onclick="page('teamlead')"><span>👁</span><b>All Submissions</b></a>
      <a href="#" id="navProfile" onclick="page('profile')"><span>♙</span><b>Profile</b></a>
      <a href="#" onclick="logout()"><span>⇥</span><b>Logout</b></a>
    </nav>
    <div class="sidebar-bottom">© 2026 Bhavi System<br>Powered By Sai Kowshik</div>
  </aside>

  <main class="main">
    <header class="topbar">
      <h1 id="pageTitle">Dashboard</h1>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
        <button id="dashContactAdmin" class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:9px 14px;font-size:13px" onclick="showAdminContact()">Contact Admin</button>
        <div class="user">👤 Welcome, <span id="userName">User</span></div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div class="content">
      <!-- DASHBOARD -->
      <section id="dashboardPage">
        <div class="grid">
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-head">Work Submission</div>
            <div class="card-body">
              <div class="upload-box" id="imageDrop" onclick="document.getElementById('imageInput').click()">
                <div class="upload-icon">☁️</div><div class="upload-title">Click to upload image</div>
                <div>or drag and drop</div><div class="small">JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP (Max 5MB)</div>
                <input id="imageInput" type="file" accept="image/*" hidden onchange="imageSelected(this)">
              </div>
              <div id="imageList" class="file-list"></div>

              <div class="upload-box" id="fileDrop" onclick="document.getElementById('fileInput').click()">
                <div class="upload-icon">☁️</div><div class="upload-title">Click to upload files</div>
                <div>or drag and drop</div><div class="small">PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, ZIP (Max 20MB each)</div>
                <input id="fileInput" type="file" multiple hidden onchange="filesSelected(this)">
              </div>
              <div id="filesList" class="file-list"></div>

              <div class="form-group">
                <label>3. Comment</label>
                <textarea id="comment" placeholder="Write your comment here..."></textarea>
              </div>
              <div class="submit-row"><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="submitDocuments()">Submit Work</button></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-head">Today's Work</div>
            <div class="card-body">
              <div class="form-group"><label>1. Site</label><input id="site" placeholder="Enter site name"></div>
              <div class="form-group"><label>2. Name</label><input id="workName" placeholder="Enter your name"></div>
              <div class="form-group"><label>3. Shift</label>
                <input id="shift" type="text" placeholder="Enter shift (e.g. Morning, Evening, Night)">
              </div>
              <div class="form-group"><label>4. Today's Work</label><textarea id="todayWork" placeholder="Describe today's work..."></textarea></div>
              <div class="form-group"><label>5. Allowance - Food</label><input id="foodAllowance" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="Enter food allowance"></div>
              <div class="form-group"><label>6. Allowance - Travel</label><input id="travelAllowance" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" placeholder="Enter travel allowance"></div>
              <div class="submit-row"><button class="btn btn-success" onclick="submitWork()">Submit Today's Work</button></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card table-card">
          <div class="card-head">My Recent Submissions</div>
          <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Site</th><th>Shift</th><th>Work</th><th>Food</th><th>Travel</th><th>Total</th><th>Files</th></tr></thead><tbody id="myRecent"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- WORK -->
      <section id="workPage" class="hidden">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-head">My Work History</div>
          <div class="toolbar"><input class="search" id="mySearch" oninput="renderMyWork()" placeholder="Search my work..."></div>
          <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Site</th><th>Name</th><th>Shift</th><th>Today's Work</th><th>Food</th><th>Travel</th><th>Total Allowance</th><th>Documents</th><th>View</th></tr></thead><tbody id="myWorkTable"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ADMIN -->
      <section id="adminPage" class="hidden">
        <div class="stats">
          <div class="stat"><div class="n" id="adminSub">0</div><div class="l">All Submissions</div></div>
          <div class="stat"><div class="n" id="adminUsers">0</div><div class="l">Registered Users</div></div>
          <div class="stat"><div class="n" id="adminFiles">0</div><div class="l">All Files</div></div>
          <div class="stat"><div class="n" id="adminAllow">₹0</div><div class="l">Total Allowances</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-head">Admin Panel - All Submissions</div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <input class="search" id="adminSearch" oninput="renderAdmin()" placeholder="Search site, name, shift or work...">
            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="exportCSV()">⬇ Export CSV</button>
            <button class="btn btn-danger" onclick="clearSubmissions()">Delete All</button>
          </div>
          <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Date</th><th>Site</th><th>Name</th><th>Shift</th><th>Today's Work</th><th>Food</th><th>Travel</th><th>Total Allowance</th><th>Image</th><th>Files</th><th>Comment</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody id="adminTable"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- TEAM LEAD - ALL SUBMISSIONS (VIEW ONLY) -->
      <section id="teamleadPage" class="hidden">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-head">All Submissions (View Only)</div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <input class="search" id="teamleadSearch" oninput="renderTeamLead()" placeholder="Search site, name, shift or work...">
          </div>
          <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Date</th><th>Site</th><th>Name</th><th>Shift</th><th>Today's Work</th><th>Food</th><th>Travel</th><th>Total Allowance</th><th>Image</th><th>Files</th><th>Comment</th><th>View</th></tr></thead><tbody id="teamleadTable"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- REGISTERED USERS -->
      <section id="usersPage" class="hidden">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-head">Registered Users</div>
          <div class="toolbar"><input class="search" id="usersSearch" oninput="renderAdmin()" placeholder="Search name, UPL, email or mobile..."></div>
          <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Name</th><th>UPL Number</th><th>Email</th><th>Mobile</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody id="adminUsersTable"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- CONTACT MESSAGES -->
      <section id="messagesPage" class="hidden">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-head">Contact Admin Messages</div>
          <div class="toolbar"><input class="search" id="messagesSearch" oninput="renderAdmin()" placeholder="Search email, mobile or message..."></div>
          <div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Date</th><th>Email</th><th>Mobile</th><th>Message</th></tr></thead><tbody id="adminContactTable"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- PROFILE -->
      <section id="profilePage" class="hidden">
        <div class="card" style="max-width:600px">
          <div class="card-head">My Profile</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            <div class="form-group"><label>Full Name</label><input id="profileName"></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>Email</label><input id="profileEmail" disabled></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>Mobile Number</label><input id="profileMobile" type="tel" pattern="[0-9]{10}" maxlength="10" placeholder="Enter 10-digit mobile number"></div>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveProfile()">Save Profile</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card" id="userPassCard" style="max-width:600px;margin-top:20px;display:none">
          <div class="card-head">Change Password</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            <div class="form-group"><label>Current Password</label><input id="userCurrentPass" type="password" placeholder="Enter current password"></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>New Password</label><input id="userNewPass" type="password" minlength="6" placeholder="Minimum 6 characters"></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>Confirm New Password</label><input id="userConfirmPass" type="password" placeholder="Confirm new password"></div>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveUserPassword()">Update Password</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card" id="adminCredsCard" style="max-width:600px;margin-top:20px;display:none">
          <div class="card-head">Change Admin Email &amp; Password</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            <div class="form-group"><label>New Admin Email</label><input id="adminNewEmail" type="email" placeholder="Enter new admin email"></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>New Password</label><input id="adminNewPass" type="password" minlength="6" placeholder="Minimum 6 characters"></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>Confirm New Password</label><input id="adminConfirmPass" type="password" placeholder="Confirm new password"></div>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveAdminCreds()">Update Admin Credentials</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card" id="teamleadCredsCard" style="max-width:600px;margin-top:20px;display:none">
          <div class="card-head">Change Team Lead Email &amp; Password</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            <div class="form-group"><label>New Team Lead Email</label><input id="teamleadNewEmail" type="email" placeholder="Enter new team lead email"></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>New Password</label><input id="teamleadNewPass" type="password" minlength="6" placeholder="Minimum 6 characters"></div>
            <div class="form-group"><label>Confirm New Password</label><input id="teamleadConfirmPass" type="password" placeholder="Confirm new password"></div>
            <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveTeamLeadCreds()">Update Team Lead Credentials</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  </main>
</div>

<div id="modal" class="modal" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeModal()">
  <div class="modal-box">
    <div class="modal-head"><span id="modalTitle">Submission</span><button class="close" onclick="closeModal()">×</button></div>
    <div class="modal-body" id="modalBody"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
let ADMIN_EMAIL=localStorage.getItem('dms_admin_email')||'admin@dms.com';
let ADMIN_PASS=localStorage.getItem('dms_admin_pass')||'admin123';
let TEAMLEAD_EMAIL=localStorage.getItem('dms_teamlead_email')||'teamlead@dms.com';
let TEAMLEAD_PASS=localStorage.getItem('dms_teamlead_pass')||'teamlead123';
let users=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dms_users')||'[]');
let submissions=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dms_submissions')||'[]');
let contactMessages=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dms_contact')||'[]');
let currentUser=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('dms_current')||'null');
let selectedImage=null, selectedFiles=[];

function save(){localStorage.setItem('dms_users',JSON.stringify(users));localStorage.setItem('dms_submissions',JSON.stringify(submissions));localStorage.setItem('dms_contact',JSON.stringify(contactMessages))}
function toast(msg){const t=document.getElementById('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2600)}
function showAuth(type){
 document.getElementById('loginForm').classList.toggle('hidden',type!=='login');
 document.getElementById('registerForm').classList.toggle('hidden',type!=='register');
 document.getElementById('loginTab').classList.toggle('active',type==='login');
 document.getElementById('registerTab').classList.toggle('active',type==='register');
}
function register(e){
 e.preventDefault();
 const name=regName.value.trim(),upl=regUpl.value.trim(),email=regEmail.value.trim().toLowerCase(),mobile=regMobile.value.trim(),pass=regPassword.value;
 if(!/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(mobile))return toast('Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number');
 if(pass!==regConfirm.value)return toast('Passwords do not match');
 if(email===ADMIN_EMAIL||email===TEAMLEAD_EMAIL)return toast('This email is reserved');
 if(users.some(u=>u.email===email))return toast('Email already registered');
 if(users.some(u=>u.mobile===mobile))return toast('Mobile number already registered');
 users.push({id:Date.now(),name,upl,email,mobile,password:pass,status:'active'});save();toast('Registration successful. Please login.');showAuth('login');loginEmail.value=email;
}
function login(e){
 e.preventDefault();const email=loginEmail.value.trim().toLowerCase(),pass=loginPassword.value;
 if(email===ADMIN_EMAIL&&pass===ADMIN_PASS){currentUser={name:'Administrator',email,admin:true};sessionStorage.setItem('dms_current',JSON.stringify(currentUser));openApp();page('admin');return}
 if(email===TEAMLEAD_EMAIL&&pass===TEAMLEAD_PASS){currentUser={name:'Team Lead',email,admin:false,teamlead:true};sessionStorage.setItem('dms_current',JSON.stringify(currentUser));openApp();page('teamlead');return}
 const u=users.find(x=>x.email===email&&x.password===pass);
 if(!u)return toast('Invalid email or password');
 if(u.status==='blocked')return toast('Your account has been blocked. Contact admin.');
 if(u.status==='hold')return toast('Your account is on hold. Contact admin.');
 currentUser={...u,admin:false};sessionStorage.setItem('dms_current',JSON.stringify(currentUser));openApp();page('dashboard');
}
function openApp(){auth.style.display='none';app.style.display='block';userName.textContent=currentUser.name;workName.value=currentUser.name;profileName.value=currentUser.name;profileEmail.value=currentUser.email;profileMobile.value=currentUser.mobile||'';navAdmin.style.display=currentUser.admin?'':'none';navUsers.style.display=currentUser.admin?'':'none';navMessages.style.display=currentUser.admin?'':'none';navTeamLead.style.display=currentUser.teamlead?'':'none';navDash.style.display=(currentUser.admin||currentUser.teamlead)?'none':'';navWork.style.display=(currentUser.admin||currentUser.teamlead)?'none':'';navProfile.style.display=currentUser.teamlead?'none':'';adminCredsCard.style.display=currentUser.admin?'block':'none';teamleadCredsCard.style.display=currentUser.admin?'block':'none';userPassCard.style.display=(currentUser.admin||currentUser.teamlead)?'none':'block';dashContactAdmin.style.display=(currentUser.admin||currentUser.teamlead)?'none':''}
function logout(){sessionStorage.removeItem('dms_current');location.reload()}
function page(p){
 if(currentUser.teamlead&&p!=='teamlead')p='teamlead';
 ['dashboard','work','admin','users','messages','profile','teamlead'].forEach(x=>document.getElementById(x+'Page').classList.add('hidden'));
 document.getElementById(p+'Page').classList.remove('hidden');
 document.querySelectorAll('.nav a').forEach(a=>a.classList.remove('active'));
 const map={dashboard:'navDash',work:'navWork',admin:'navAdmin',users:'navUsers',messages:'navMessages',teamlead:'navTeamLead'};
 if(map[p])document.getElementById(map[p]).classList.add('active');
 pageTitle.textContent=p==='dashboard'?'Dashboard':p==='work'?'My Work':p==='admin'?'Admin Panel':p==='users'?'Registered Users':p==='messages'?'Contact Messages':p==='teamlead'?'All Submissions':'My Profile';
 if((p==='admin'||p==='users'||p==='messages')&&!currentUser.admin){toast('Admin access only');return page('dashboard')}
 if(p==='teamlead'&&!currentUser.teamlead){toast('Access denied');return page(currentUser.admin?'admin':'dashboard')}
 if((p==='dashboard'||p==='work')&&currentUser.admin){return page('admin')}
 renderAll();
}
function imageSelected(input){const f=input.files[0];if(!f)return;if(f.size>5*1024*1024)return toast('Image must be 5MB or less');readFile(f,true)}
function filesSelected(input){selectedFiles=[];const arr=[...input.files];for(const f of arr){if(f.size>20*1024*1024){toast(f.name+' exceeds 20MB');continue}readFile(f,false)}}
function readFile(file,isImage){
 const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{const obj={name:file.name,type:file.type,size:file.size,data:r.result};if(isImage){selectedImage=obj;imageList.innerHTML='<div>🖼️ '+escapeHtml(file.name)+'</div>'}else{selectedFiles.push(obj);filesList.innerHTML=selectedFiles.map(f=>'<div>📎 '+escapeHtml(f.name)+'</div>').join('')}};r.readAsDataURL(file)
}
function submitDocuments(){
 if(!selectedImage&&!selectedFiles.length&&!comment.value.trim())return toast('Add an image, file or comment first');
 submissions.push({id:Date.now(),date:new Date().toLocaleString(),email:currentUser.email,name:currentUser.name,site:'—',shift:'—',work:'Document upload',allowance:0,image:selectedImage,files:selectedFiles,comment:comment.value.trim()});
 save();selectedImage=null;selectedFiles=[];imageInput.value='';fileInput.value='';imageList.innerHTML='';filesList.innerHTML='';comment.value='';toast('Documents submitted successfully');renderAll();
}
function submitWork(){
 const s=site.value.trim(),n=workName.value.trim(),sh=shift.value,w=todayWork.value.trim();
 const food=parseFloat(foodAllowance.value)||0, travel=parseFloat(travelAllowance.value)||0, total=food+travel;
 if(!s||!n||!sh||!w)return toast('Please complete all required work fields');
 submissions.push({
   id:Date.now(),date:new Date().toLocaleString(),email:currentUser.email,name:n,site:s,shift:sh,
   work:w,foodAllowance:food,travelAllowance:travel,allowance:total,image:null,files:[],comment:''
 });
 save();site.value='';shift.value='';todayWork.value='';foodAllowance.value='';travelAllowance.value='';
 toast('Today’s work submitted successfully');renderAll();
}
function renderAll(){renderStats();renderMyWork();renderAdmin();renderRecent();renderTeamLead()}
function renderTeamLead(){
 if(!currentUser?.teamlead)return;
 const q=(teamleadSearch?.value||'').toLowerCase();
 const data=submissions.filter(s=>JSON.stringify(s).toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice().reverse();

 teamleadTable.innerHTML=data.map((s,i)=>`<tr>
 <td>${i+1}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.date)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.site)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.name)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.shift)}</td>
 <td>${escapeHtml(s.work)}</td><td>₹${Number(s.foodAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₹${Number(s.travelAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₹${Number(s.allowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
 <td>${s.image?`<img class="thumb" src="${s.image.data}" onclick="viewSubmission(${s.id})">`:'—'}</td>
 <td>${(s.files||[]).map(f=>`<a class="link" href="${f.data}" download="${escapeAttr(f.name)}">📎 ${escapeHtml(f.name)}</a>`).join('')||'—'}</td>
 <td>${escapeHtml(s.comment||'—')}</td>
 <td><button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px" onclick="viewSubmission(${s.id})">View</button></td>
 </tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="13">No submissions found.</td></tr>';
}
function userSubs(){return submissions.filter(s=>s.email===currentUser.email)}
function renderStats(){
 adminSub.textContent=submissions.length;adminUsers.textContent=users.length;adminFiles.textContent=submissions.reduce((n,s)=>n+(s.files||[]).length,0);adminAllow.textContent='₹'+submissions.reduce((n,s)=>n+(Number(s.allowance)||0),0).toLocaleString();
}
function renderRecent(){
 myRecent.innerHTML=userSubs().slice(-8).reverse().map(s=>`<tr><td>${escapeHtml(s.date)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.site)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.shift)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.work)}</td><td>₹${Number(s.foodAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₹${Number(s.travelAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₹${Number(s.allowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${(s.files||[]).length}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="8">No submissions yet.</td></tr>';
}
function renderMyWork(){
 const q=(mySearch?.value||'').toLowerCase(),data=userSubs().filter(s=>JSON.stringify(s).toLowerCase().includes(q));
 myWorkTable.innerHTML=data.slice().reverse().map((s,i)=>`<tr><td>${escapeHtml(s.date)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.site)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.name)}</td><td><span class="badge">${escapeHtml(s.shift)}</span></td><td>${escapeHtml(s.work)}</td><td>₹${Number(s.foodAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₹${Number(s.travelAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₹${Number(s.allowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${(s.files||[]).length+(s.image?1:0)}</td><td><button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px" onclick="viewSubmission(${s.id})">View</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="10">No work found.</td></tr>';
}
function renderAdmin(){
 if(!currentUser?.admin)return;
 const q=(adminSearch?.value||'').toLowerCase();
 const data=submissions.filter(s=>JSON.stringify(s).toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice().reverse();
 adminTable.innerHTML=data.map((s,i)=>`<tr>
 <td>${i+1}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.date)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.site)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.name)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(s.shift)}</td>
 <td>${escapeHtml(s.work)}</td><td>₹${Number(s.foodAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₹${Number(s.travelAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td><td>₹${Number(s.allowance||0).toLocaleString()}</td>
 <td>${s.image?`<img class="thumb" src="${s.image.data}" onclick="viewSubmission(${s.id})">`:'—'}</td>
 <td>${(s.files||[]).map(f=>`<a class="link" href="${f.data}" download="${escapeAttr(f.name)}">📎 ${escapeHtml(f.name)}</a>`).join('')||'—'}</td>
 <td>${escapeHtml(s.comment||'—')}</td>
 <td><button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px" onclick="viewSubmission(${s.id})">View</button></td>
 </tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="13">No submissions found.</td></tr>';
 adminUsersTable.innerHTML=users.filter(u=>JSON.stringify(u).toLowerCase().includes((usersSearch?.value||'').toLowerCase())).map((u,i)=>{
  const st=u.status||'active';
  const badge=st==='blocked'?'<span class="badge" style="background:#fde2e1;color:#c0392b">Blocked</span>':st==='hold'?'<span class="badge" style="background:#fff2cc;color:#a67c00">On Hold</span>':'<span class="badge" style="background:#e3f6e8;color:#1e8e4a">Active</span>';
  return `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${escapeHtml(u.name)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(u.upl||'—')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(u.email)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(u.mobile||'—')}</td><td>${badge}</td>
  <td>
   ${st!=='blocked'?`<button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px" onclick="setUserStatus(${u.id},'blocked')">Block</button>`:''}
   ${st!=='hold'?`<button class="btn" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;background:#fff2cc;color:#a67c00" onclick="setUserStatus(${u.id},'hold')">Hold</button>`:''}
   ${st!=='active'?`<button class="btn btn-primary" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px" onclick="setUserStatus(${u.id},'active')">Activate</button>`:''}
   <button class="btn btn-danger" style="padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px" onclick="removeUser(${u.id})">Remove</button>
  </td></tr>`;
 }).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="7">No registered users.</td></tr>';
 adminContactTable.innerHTML=contactMessages.filter(m=>JSON.stringify(m).toLowerCase().includes((messagesSearch?.value||'').toLowerCase())).slice().reverse().map((m,i)=>`<tr><td>${contactMessages.length-i}</td><td>${escapeHtml(m.date)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(m.email||'—')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(m.mobile||'—')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(m.message)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="5">No messages.</td></tr>';
}
function setUserStatus(id,status){
 const u=users.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!u)return;
 u.status=status;save();renderAll();
 toast('User '+(status==='blocked'?'blocked':status==='hold'?'put on hold':'activated'));
}
function removeUser(id){
 const u=users.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!u)return;
 if(!confirm('Remove '+u.name+' ('+u.email+')? This cannot be undone.'))return;
 users=users.filter(x=>x.id!==id);save();renderAll();toast('User removed');
}
function viewSubmission(id){
 const s=submissions.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!s)return;
 modalTitle.textContent='Submission Details';
 modalBody.innerHTML=`<p><b>Date:</b> ${escapeHtml(s.date)}</p><p><b>Name:</b> ${escapeHtml(s.name)}</p><p><b>Email:</b> ${escapeHtml(s.email)}</p><p><b>Site:</b> ${escapeHtml(s.site)}</p><p><b>Shift:</b> ${escapeHtml(s.shift)}</p><p><b>Today's Work:</b> ${escapeHtml(s.work)}</p><p><b>Food Allowance:</b> ₹${Number(s.foodAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</p>
 <p><b>Travel Allowance:</b> ₹${Number(s.travelAllowance||0).toLocaleString()}</p>
 <p><b>Total Allowance:</b> ₹${Number(s.allowance||0).toLocaleString()}</p><p><b>Comment:</b> ${escapeHtml(s.comment||'—')}</p>
 ${s.image?`<p><b>Image:</b></p><img class="preview-img" src="${s.image.data}">`:''}
 <p><b>Files:</b></p>${(s.files||[]).map(f=>`<a class="link" href="${f.data}" download="${escapeAttr(f.name)}">⬇ ${escapeHtml(f.name)}</a>`).join('')||'No files.'}`;
 modal.classList.add('open');
}
function closeModal(){modal.classList.remove('open')}
function showAdminContact(){
 modalTitle.textContent='Contact Admin';
 modalBody.innerHTML=`<p>1. Having trouble logging in, registering, or need help with your account? Please contact the admin.</p>
 <div class="form-group" style="margin-top:14px"><label>Your Email</label><input id="troubleEmail" type="email" placeholder="Enter your email" style="width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:inherit" value="${escapeAttr(currentUser?.email||loginEmail?.value||'')}"></div>
 <div class="form-group" style="margin-top:14px"><label>Mobile Number</label><input id="troubleMobile" type="tel" maxlength="10" pattern="[0-9]{10}" placeholder="Enter your mobile number" style="width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:inherit" value="${escapeAttr(currentUser?.mobile||'')}"></div>
 <div class="form-group" style="margin-top:14px"><label>Describe your issue</label><textarea id="troubleText" rows="4" placeholder="Type your issue here..." style="width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-family:inherit;resize:vertical"></textarea></div>
 <button class="btn btn-primary full" onclick="sendTroubleMessage()">Send to Admin</button>`;
 modal.classList.add('open');
}
function sendTroubleMessage(){
 const email=troubleEmail.value.trim().toLowerCase();
 const mobile=troubleMobile.value.trim();
 const msg=troubleText.value.trim();
 if(!email)return toast('Please enter your email');
 if(!mobile)return toast('Please enter your mobile number');
 if(!/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(mobile))return toast('Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number');
 if(!msg)return toast('Please describe your issue');
 contactMessages.push({id:Date.now(),email,mobile,message:msg,date:new Date().toLocaleString()});
 save();toast('Message sent to admin');closeModal();
}
function saveProfile(){
 const n=profileName.value.trim();if(!n)return toast('Enter your name');
 const m=profileMobile.value.trim();
 if(m&&!/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(m))return toast('Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number');
 const u=users.find(x=>x.email===currentUser.email);if(u){u.name=n;u.mobile=m;currentUser.name=n;currentUser.mobile=m;save();sessionStorage.setItem('dms_current',JSON.stringify(currentUser));userName.textContent=n;workName.value=n;toast('Profile updated')}
}
function saveUserPassword(){
 if(currentUser.admin)return;
 const cur=userCurrentPass.value,newPass=userNewPass.value,confirmPass=userConfirmPass.value;
 if(!cur)return toast('Enter your current password');
 if(!newPass||newPass.length<6)return toast('New password must be at least 6 characters');
 if(newPass!==confirmPass)return toast('Passwords do not match');
 const u=users.find(x=>x.email===currentUser.email);
 if(!u||u.password!==cur)return toast('Current password is incorrect');
 u.password=newPass;save();
 userCurrentPass.value='';userNewPass.value='';userConfirmPass.value='';
 toast('Password updated');
}
function saveAdminCreds(){
 if(!currentUser.admin)return;
 const newEmail=adminNewEmail.value.trim().toLowerCase(),newPass=adminNewPass.value,confirmPass=adminConfirmPass.value;
 if(!newEmail&&!newPass)return toast('Enter a new email or password to update');
 if(newPass&&newPass.length<6)return toast('Password must be at least 6 characters');
 if(newPass&&newPass!==confirmPass)return toast('Passwords do not match');
 if(newEmail&&users.some(u=>u.email===newEmail))return toast('That email is already used by a registered user');
 if(newEmail){ADMIN_EMAIL=newEmail;localStorage.setItem('dms_admin_email',ADMIN_EMAIL);currentUser.email=ADMIN_EMAIL;profileEmail.value=ADMIN_EMAIL;sessionStorage.setItem('dms_current',JSON.stringify(currentUser))}
 if(newPass){ADMIN_PASS=newPass;localStorage.setItem('dms_admin_pass',ADMIN_PASS)}
 adminNewEmail.value='';adminNewPass.value='';adminConfirmPass.value='';
 toast('Admin credentials updated');
}
function saveTeamLeadCreds(){
 if(!currentUser.admin)return;
 const newEmail=teamleadNewEmail.value.trim().toLowerCase(),newPass=teamleadNewPass.value,confirmPass=teamleadConfirmPass.value;
 if(!newEmail&&!newPass)return toast('Enter a new email or password to update');
 if(newPass&&newPass.length<6)return toast('Password must be at least 6 characters');
 if(newPass&&newPass!==confirmPass)return toast('Passwords do not match');
 if(newEmail&&newEmail===ADMIN_EMAIL)return toast('That email is reserved for admin');
 if(newEmail&&users.some(u=>u.email===newEmail))return toast('That email is already used by a registered user');
 if(newEmail){TEAMLEAD_EMAIL=newEmail;localStorage.setItem('dms_teamlead_email',TEAMLEAD_EMAIL)}
 if(newPass){TEAMLEAD_PASS=newPass;localStorage.setItem('dms_teamlead_pass',TEAMLEAD_PASS)}
 teamleadNewEmail.value='';teamleadNewPass.value='';teamleadConfirmPass.value='';
 toast('Team Lead credentials updated');
}
function clearSubmissions(){if(!currentUser.admin)return;if(confirm('Delete ALL submissions? This cannot be undone.')){submissions=[];save();renderAll();toast('All submissions deleted')}}
function exportCSV(){
 if(!currentUser.admin)return;
 const rows=[['Date','Email','Name','Site','Shift',"Today's Work",'Food Allowance','Travel Allowance','Total Allowance','Image','Files','Comment'],...submissions.map(s=>[s.date,s.email,s.name,s.site,s.shift,s.work,s.foodAllowance||0,s.travelAllowance||0,s.allowance||0,s.image?.name||'',(s.files||[]).map(f=>f.name).join('; '),s.comment||''])];
 const csv=rows.map(r=>r.map(v=>`"${String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')}"`).join(',')).join('\\n');
 const blob=new Blob([csv],{type:'text/csv'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='dms-submissions.csv';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
function escapeHtml(x){return String(x??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[m]))}
function escapeAttr(x){return escapeHtml(x).replace(/`/g,'&#096;')}

/* drag and drop */
['imageDrop','fileDrop'].forEach(id=>{
 const box=document.getElementById(id);
 ['dragenter','dragover'].forEach(ev=>box.addEventListener(ev,e=>{e.preventDefault();box.classList.add('drag')}));
 ['dragleave','drop'].forEach(ev=>box.addEventListener(ev,e=>{e.preventDefault();box.classList.remove('drag')}));
 box.addEventListener('drop',e=>{const files=e.dataTransfer.files;if(id==='imageDrop'){if(files[0]){imageInput.files=files;imageSelected(imageInput)}}else{fileInput.files=files;filesSelected(fileInput)}})
});
if(currentUser){openApp();page(currentUser.admin?'admin':currentUser.teamlead?'teamlead':'dashboard')}
</script>
</body>
</html>
